# CGB Industries

> Owner-operated pressure washing and concrete sealing business on the
> Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia, for residential and commercial
> properties.

CGB Industries is a service-area business covering Buderim, Forest Glen,
Maroochydore, Mooloolaba, Caloundra, Nambour, Sippy Downs, Mountain Creek,
Mons and the wider Sunshine Coast. The owner quotes and performs every job
— no subcontractors. Quotes are free and usually returned within 48 hours.

Contact: 0414 438 169 | cgbindustries@outlook.com.au
ABN 12 508 435 400

## Services

- [Pressure Washing](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing): Rotary
  surface cleaning for driveways, carparks, paths, pool surrounds, alfresco
  and patio areas, fencing, retaining walls and body corporate common areas.
  Rotary surface cleaners are used rather than hand-held wands, giving an
  even finish without striping or etching. Covers recommended cleaning
  frequency, the four-step process and FAQs.
- [Driveway Cleaning](https://cgbindustries.com.au/driveway-cleaning):
  Cleaning of concrete, exposed aggregate, coloured and stamped driveways.
  Covers what builds up on Sunshine Coast driveways, what comes out and what
  may only lighten, the process and FAQs.
- [Concrete Sealing](https://cgbindustries.com.au/concrete-sealing): Clear
  sealing, colour enhancement for exposed aggregate and coloured concrete,
  penetrating sealer and anti-slip coatings, with strong UV resistance. Covers what
  sealing protects against in a coastal Queensland climate, sealer cure
  times and FAQs.
- [Exposed Aggregate Sealing](https://cgbindustries.com.au/exposed-aggregate-sealing):
  Cleaning and sealing of exposed aggregate driveways, paths and entries,
  with clear or colour-enhancing sealer and anti-slip options.
- [Pool Surround, Paver and Path Cleaning](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pool-surround-and-path-cleaning):
  Rotary cleaning of pool surrounds, pavers, paths and alfresco areas, lifting
  the algae and mould that make paving slippery.
- [Stair and Retaining Wall Cleaning](https://cgbindustries.com.au/stair-and-retaining-wall-cleaning):
  Cleaning of concrete stairs, landings and retaining walls, lifting the moss
  and algae that make shaded steps slippery, with anti-slip coating options.
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://cgbindustries.com.au/commercial-pressure-washing):
  Carparks, entrances, walkways and body corporate common areas, scoped and
  quoted per site.

## Service areas

- [Service Areas](https://cgbindustries.com.au/service-areas): Suburbs
  covered across the Sunshine Coast and how quoting works.
- [Pressure Washing Buderim](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing-buderim):
  Pressure washing and concrete sealing in Buderim. Covers why elevation and
  mature tree cover make moss and algae return faster on shaded driveways,
  the mix of plain, exposed aggregate and stamped concrete across the
  suburb's varied housing stock, and access on steep driveways, stairs and
  retaining walls.
- [Pressure Washing Forest Glen](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing-forest-glen):
  Pressure washing and concrete sealing in Forest Glen. Covers the estate
  exposed aggregate driveways of similar age now reaching the point where
  sealing pays off, and why UV fade and surface wear, rather than moss,
  are the main issues in an open, sun-exposed suburb.
- [Pressure Washing Maroochydore](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing-maroochydore):
  Home driveways and paths plus commercial and strata carparks, entrances and
  common areas in the Sunshine Coast's main commercial centre, with salt air
  and humidity as the local factors.
- [Pressure Washing Mooloolaba](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing-mooloolaba):
  Pool surrounds, pavers, alfresco areas and driveways near the beach, where
  salt and humidity make paving slippery, with a four-step clean process and
  anti-slip sealing options.
- [Pressure Washing Caloundra](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing-caloundra):
  Driveways, paths and pavers across older and newer parts of Caloundra, and
  what cleaning can and cannot lift from older porous concrete.
- [Pressure Washing Nambour](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing-nambour):
  Moss and algae on shaded stairs, retaining walls, paths and sloping
  driveways in the inland hinterland.

- Business type: service-area business, no public shopfront
